# Set-ZbxIconMap

## SYNOPSIS

Changes an icon map.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxIconMap [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixIconMap>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-DefaultIconId <ulong>] [-Mapping <ZabbixIconMapMappingRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An icon map picks a map element's icon from the host's inventory, such as a router icon for every host whose inventory type is router. The Set-ZbxIconMap cmdlet changes the icon maps given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with iconmap.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every icon map the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed icon maps back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change an icon map

```powershell
Set-ZbxIconMap -InputObject 'Server icons' -Name 'Server and router icons'
```

Renames the icon map Server icons to Server and router icons.

### Example 2: Change an icon map and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxIconMap -InputObject 'Server icons' -Name 'Server and router icons' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the icon map Server icons back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.
